title: Amerisun Recalls to Repair Snow Blowers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The pulley bolt can loosen and cause the snow blower to get stuck in drive mode, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 34,600 (in addition, about 11,800 were sold in Canada).

title: GE Lighting Recalls LED Tube Lamps Due to Shock and Electrocution Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Lowe's Stores
summary: The pins on one end of the lamp can be energized during installation/removal, posing electric shock and electrocution hazards. Units: About 46,000 packages of two tube lamps (92,000 individual lamps).

title: Vernier Software & Technology Recalls Circuit Boards Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: There are two switches on the VCB2 that can get stuck between positions causing the switches to short out and overheat. If the switches overheat, the metal case of the switch can become hot, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 4,200.

title: Keyera Energy Recalls to Inspect Propane Gas Due to Fire and Explosion Hazards
summary: The recalled propane gas does not contain sufficient levels of odorant to help alert consumers to a gas leak. Failure to detect leaking gas can present fire, explosion and thermal burn hazards. Units: About 1.7 million gallons.

title: Werner Recalls Aluminum Ladders Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The ladders can break while in use, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 78,000.

title: Women's Scarves Recalled by Yangtze Store Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard Hazard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The women's scarves fail to meet the federal flammability standard for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 640.

title: A&I Recalls Tractor Canopies Due To Injury Hazard
summary: The canopies do not meet design specifications and can cause the tractor's Rollover Protective Structure (ROPS) to fail to protect the operator in a rollover accident, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 6,200 (In addition, about 265 in Canada).

title: Ashley Furniture Recalls Floor Lamps Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The incorrect label on the lamp states that consumers can use 40 watt lightbulbs in the product. However, the socket is only designed to support 25 watt lightbulbs. Use of incorrect wattage lightbulbs can melt the power switch, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 900 (in addition, about 100 were sold

title: Ketra Recalls to Inspect Recessed Downlights Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The downlights power supply connectors can have incorrect wiring, posing an electric shock hazard to the user. Units: About 3,400.

title: Lorex Recalls Three Models of Video Monitors Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The video monitor's batteries can overheat, swell and expand and cause the battery cover to open or come off and expose hot batteries, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 22,000 (In addition, 4,300 were sold in Canada).

title: Uttermost Recalls Mirrors, Art and Wall Decor Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The hanging hardware can break and allow the decor to fall, posing an injury hazard to bystanders. Units: About 17,000.

title: BRP Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Fuel can spray from the fuel tank when opening the gas cap, posing a fuel leak and fire hazard. Units: About 13,300.

title: Helmets R Us Recalls Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The helmets fail to meet the federal safety standard, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 9,700.

title: Baccus Recalls Stanley Workbench LED Light and Power Stations Due to Shock and Electrocution Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled workbench and power stations are wired incorrectly, which can result in reverse polarity, posing shock and electrocution hazards. Units: About 20,000.

title: Huish Outdoors Recalls Scuba Diving Regulators Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The scuba diving regulators can restrict airflow at low tank pressures (below 500 psi), posing a drowning hazard to divers. Units: About 4,500 (In addition, 330 were sold in Canada).
